title: Week of 20 November 2026
notes: New: the story of Prophet Ya'qub, alayhis salaam (the next Prophet in order without a story), 21 gems on patience, hope in Allah's mercy, trust in Allah and family, and 10 Jumu'ah quiz questions. Sources: the Qur'an (every Arabic line checked word for word against the Uthmani text from the Noble Qur'an Encyclopedia and written in the simple spelling the app uses; meanings checked against the Saheeh International translation) and Sahih al-Bukhari and Sahih Muslim (numbers checked on sunnah.com and hadithunlocked.com). abdurrahman.org and quran.com could not be reached from this run, so the story relies on the Qur'an and the two Sahihs only. Please read carefully: most of what the Qur'an tells about Ya'qub is inside Surah Yusuf, so slides 4 to 9 overlap with the Yusuf series, told this time from Ya'qub's side and mostly with different ayat (12:67, 12:83, 12:94, 12:98). Slide 6 says three sons were away: Yusuf, the youngest brother and the eldest brother who stayed in Egypt (Surah Yusuf 12:80). The youngest brother and the eldest are left unnamed because the Qur'an does not name them. Ya'qub's other name, Isra'il, is left out because no reference in the Qur'an, al-Bukhari or Muslim that states it outright could be confirmed in this run. Slide 8 says the caravan set off; the ayah does not say from where. Gem 5 mentions the death of the Prophet's ﷺ baby son Ibrahim, gently worded. Gem 18 leaves out the part about spitting lightly to the left, to keep it short.

stories.title: Prophet Ya'qub and beautiful patience
stories.sub: Be patient, tell your sadness to Allah, and never lose hope

sc.label: Palm trees and green hills at sunrise

slides.text: Prophet Ibrahim, alayhis salaam, left his people for the sake of Allah. Allah gave him a son, Ishaq, and then a grandson, Ya'qub, as an extra gift. Allah made every one of them good and righteous.

ay.ar: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُ إِسْحَاقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ نَافِلَةً وَكُلًّا جَعَلْنَا صَالِحِينَ
ay.en: And We gave him Ishaq, and Ya'qub as an extra gift, and We made each of them righteous.

sc.label: Tall mountains with a soft light above them

slides.text: Ya'qub, alayhis salaam, grew up and Allah made him a Prophet. Allah praised him, his father and his grandfather for being strong in worshipping Allah and wise in understanding.

ay.ar: وَاذْكُرْ عِبَادَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَإِسْحَاقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ أُولِي الْأَيْدِي وَالْأَبْصَارِ
ay.en: And remember Our servants Ibrahim, Ishaq and Ya'qub, people of strength and understanding.

sc.label: A small town at dusk with warm lit windows

slides.text: Ya'qub had many sons. Just like his grandfather Ibrahim, he gave his children the most important advice of all:

ay.ar: يَا بَنِيَّ إِنَّ اللَّهَ اصْطَفَىٰ لَكُمُ الدِّينَ فَلَا تَمُوتُنَّ إِلَّا وَأَنْتُمْ مُسْلِمُونَ
ay.en: O my sons, Allah has chosen this religion for you, so stay Muslims until the very end of your lives.

sc.label: A stone well under a dark night sky

slides.text: One of his sons was Yusuf, alayhis salaam. Yusuf's brothers were jealous, so they threw him into a well and came home with a false story. Ya'qub was very sad, but he chose beautiful patience. He said:

ay.ar: فَصَبْرٌ جَمِيلٌ وَاللَّهُ الْمُسْتَعَانُ عَلَىٰ مَا تَصِفُونَ
ay.en: So patience is beautiful, and Allah is the One whose help I ask about what you describe.

sc.label: A town under a bright sun, seen across the sand

slides.text: Years later, the brothers had to travel to Egypt for food, taking their youngest brother with them. Ya'qub told them to go in through different gates. But he knew that only Allah decides what happens, so he said:

ay.ar: إِنِ الْحُكْمُ إِلَّا لِلَّهِ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَعَلَيْهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ الْمُتَوَكِّلُونَ
ay.en: The decision is only Allah's. In Him I put my trust, and in Him let all who trust put their trust.

sc.label: Grey clouds over quiet sand hills in the evening

slides.text: The youngest brother did not come home, and the eldest brother stayed behind in Egypt too. Now three of Ya'qub's sons were far away. Still he did not give up. He said:

ay.ar: فَصَبْرٌ جَمِيلٌ عَسَى اللَّهُ أَنْ يَأْتِيَنِي بِهِمْ جَمِيعًا
ay.en: Patience is beautiful. Maybe Allah will bring them all back to me together.

sc.label: A glowing lantern under a crescent moon at night

slides.text: Ya'qub cried so much for Yusuf that his eyes turned white. But he did not complain to people. He told his sons never to lose hope in Allah's mercy (Surah Yusuf 12:87), and he said:

ay.ar: إِنَّمَا أَشْكُو بَثِّي وَحُزْنِي إِلَى اللَّهِ
ay.en: I only tell my sadness and my grief to Allah.

sc.label: Wind blowing across the desert between palm trees

slides.text: In Egypt, the brothers found Yusuf at last! Yusuf sent his shirt home to his father. As soon as the caravan set off, far, far away, Ya'qub said:

ay.en: I can truly smell the scent of Yusuf.

sc.label: A bright sunrise over a garden full of flowers

slides.text: When the shirt was laid on his face, Allah gave Ya'qub his sight back (Surah Yusuf 12:96)! His sons were sorry and asked him to pray for their forgiveness. Ya'qub said:

ay.ar: سَوْفَ أَسْتَغْفِرُ لَكُمْ رَبِّي إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ
ay.en: I will ask my Rabb to forgive you. He is the Forgiving, the Most Merciful.

sc.label: A full moon over a quiet town with lit windows

slides.text: When Ya'qub was very old, near the end of his life, he asked his sons one important question: What will you worship after me? They answered:

ay.ar: نَعْبُدُ إِلَٰهَكَ وَإِلَٰهَ آبَائِكَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَإِسْمَاعِيلَ وَإِسْحَاقَ إِلَٰهًا وَاحِدًا وَنَحْنُ لَهُ مُسْلِمُونَ
ay.en: We will worship your God, the God of your fathers Ibrahim, Isma'il and Ishaq, one God, and to Him we submit.

sc.label: A glowing lantern beside an open Qur'an

slides.text: What do we learn? When something sad happens, be patient like Ya'qub, and tell your sadness to Allah. Never lose hope in Allah's mercy. Put your trust in Allah. And the most important thing to pass on to your family is to worship Allah alone.

quiz.q: What did Ya'qub say when he was very sad?
quiz.why: He said: Fa sabrun jameel, patience is beautiful (Surah Yusuf 12:18 and 12:83).

quiz.q: Who did Ya'qub tell his sadness to?
quiz.why: He said: I only tell my sadness and my grief to Allah (Surah Yusuf 12:86).

quiz.q: What did Ya'qub smell from far away?
quiz.why: He said: I can truly smell the scent of Yusuf (Surah Yusuf 12:94).

quiz.q: What did Ya'qub ask his sons near the end of his life?
o: What will you worship after me?
quiz.why: They answered that they would worship Allah alone (Surah al-Baqarah 2:133).

gems.text: Allah says: Do not lose hope in the mercy of Allah. Allah forgives all sins.
The Prophet ﷺ said: True patience is at the very first moment something hard happens.
Allah tells us to say: We believe in Allah, and in what was sent to Ibrahim, Isma'il, Ishaq and Ya'qub, and to all the Prophets. We do not reject any of them.
At the start of Surah Yusuf, Allah says: We tell you the best of stories.
When the Prophet's ﷺ little son Ibrahim passed away, he cried and said: The eyes cry and the heart is sad, but we only say what pleases our Rabb.
When something sad happens, the patient say: We belong to Allah, and to Him we will return.
The Prophet ﷺ saw a mother holding her baby close and said: Allah is more merciful to His servants than this mother is to her child.
gems.ar: اللَّهُ أَرْحَمُ بِعِبَادِهِ مِنْ هَذِهِ بِوَلَدِهَا

gems.text: Allah says that Ibrahim, Ishaq and Ya'qub are, with Him, among the chosen and the very best.
Be patient. Allah is with those who are patient.
The Prophet ﷺ said: Do not hate each other, do not be jealous of each other, and do not turn away from each other. Be brothers, O servants of Allah.
Every Prophet that Allah sent looked after sheep. Prophet Muhammad ﷺ did too, for the people of Makkah.
Remembering Allah gives our hearts peace.
The Prophet ﷺ said: Every one of you is a caretaker, and every one of you will be asked about what was in your care.
gems.ar: كُلُّكُمْ رَاعٍ وَكُلُّكُمْ مَسْئُولٌ عَنْ رَعِيَّتِهِ

gems.text: Allah gave Ibrahim his son Ishaq and his grandson Ya'qub, and He placed prophethood and the Book among Ibrahim's children.
The Prophet ﷺ said: When a Muslim is tired, ill, worried or sad, even from the prick of a thorn, Allah wipes away some of his sins because of it.
The Prophet ﷺ said the Prophets are like brothers: their mothers are different, but their religion is one.
Allah says: Tell your family to pray, and keep praying patiently yourself.
The Prophet ﷺ said: A good dream is from Allah, and a bad dream is from Shaytan. If you have a scary dream, seek refuge with Allah from its harm, and it will not harm you.
Ya'qub told Yusuf that Allah would complete His blessing on him and on the family of Ya'qub, as He did for Ibrahim and Ishaq before.
Allah loves those who put their trust in Him.
Allah tells us that in the stories of the Prophets there is a lesson for people who think.
gems.ar: لَقَدْ كَانَ فِي قَصَصِهِمْ عِبْرَةٌ لِأُولِي الْأَلْبَابِ

quiz.q: Which Prophet was the son of Ishaq and the father of Yusuf?
quiz.why: Allah gave Ibrahim his son Ishaq and his grandson Ya'qub, and Yusuf was Ya'qub's son.

quiz.q: What did Ya'qub say about who decides what happens?
o: The decision is only Allah's, and in Him I trust
quiz.why: He said: The decision is only Allah's. In Him I put my trust (Surah Yusuf 12:67).

quiz.q: Why did Ya'qub's eyes turn white?
o: He cried so much for Yusuf
quiz.why: He was so sad about Yusuf that his eyes turned white, but he told his sadness only to Allah.

quiz.q: Who did Ya'qub's sons promise to worship?
o: Allah alone, the God of Ibrahim, Isma'il and Ishaq
quiz.why: They said: We will worship your God and the God of your fathers, one God (Surah al-Baqarah 2:133).

quiz.q: What do we say when something sad happens?
o: Inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji'un
quiz.why: We belong to Allah, and to Him we will return (Surah al-Baqarah 2:156).

o: At the very first moment something hard happens
quiz.why: The Prophet ﷺ said: True patience is at the first moment something hard happens.

quiz.q: Who is more merciful to us than a mother to her baby?
quiz.why: The Prophet ﷺ said: Allah is more merciful to His servants than this mother is to her child.

quiz.q: What did every Prophet look after?
quiz.why: Every Prophet Allah sent looked after sheep, and Prophet Muhammad ﷺ did too.
Allah says: In the remembrance of Allah, hearts find peace (Surah ar-Ra'd 13:28).

quiz.q: What should you do after a scary dream?
o: Seek refuge with Allah from its harm
quiz.why: The Prophet ﷺ said a bad dream is from Shaytan, so seek refuge with Allah and it will not harm you.
